messages:
ali: Heads-up 1h: updating docs for rate limits / quotas / usage analytics. Need three tiny artefacts: 1) PromQL panel for daily billable tokens by tier, 2) SQL snippet for data teams that handles burst credits & reserved capacity, 3) a short SDK v2 curl example showing header rename (X-Redwood-Org -> X-RW-Org).
rachel: Quick Q 1h: do we want cost calc included or just counts?
ali: Include a single extra column "estimated_cost" using model_price_mult so customers can sanity-check invoices. Keep it clear it's an estimate.
tom: For PromQL I'd suggest using the counter metric and subtract burst-covered. Something like:
```
sum by (customer_tier) (increase(redwood_tokens_total[24h])) -
sum by (customer_tier) (increase(redwood_burst_covered_tokens_total[24h]))
```
Wrap with max(...,0) in the dashboard expression if supported so negatives don't show.
lucy: SQL for data teams: assume table usage_events(ts, org_id, customer_tier, tokens, burst_covered_tokens, model_price_mult, reserved_capacity_owner_id). Example: 
```
SELECT customer_tier,
       SUM(tokens) AS raw_tokens,
       SUM(GREATEST(tokens - COALESCE(burst_covered_tokens,0), 0)) AS billable_tokens,
       SUM(GREATEST(tokens - COALESCE(burst_covered_tokens,0), 0) * COALESCE(model_price_mult, 1.0)) AS estimated_cost_units
FROM usage_events
WHERE ts >= current_date - interval '1 day'
GROUP BY customer_tier;
```
Note: for Dedicated deployments recommend joining on reserved_capacity_owner_id to roll usage up to an org or billing owner.
rachel: Also mention fallbacks: when routing falls back to cheaper model we show both route and effective_model, include a short example of multiplying by model_price_mult per row.
tom: tiny wording nit: say "bursts reduce billable tokens" not "cancel out tokens". Also clarify quota windows are UTC by default.
ali: SDK v2 curl snippet (header change):
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" \
     -H "X-RW-Org: org_abc" \
     -d '{"input":"hello"}' \
     https://api.redwoodinference.com/v1/generate
```
Explain: X-Redwood-Org is deprecated; clients should switch to X-RW-Org.
lucy: Can we add a tiny example of computing per-org daily spend when reserved_capacity_owner_id exists? Suggest a join in SQL to capacities table and coalesce to org owner.
ali: Yep will add that with a one-liner and a footnote about clock skew across regions.
docs-bot: PR created by @ali: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/943 1h reviewers: @rachel @tom
ali: Thanks team 1h. I'll address the nits then merge tomorrow if no objections. :thumbsup:
